paragraphs: Before work, mix paint and calibrate the spray gun. Put on protective equipment, enter the booth, and move steadily along the workpiece to ensure uniform coverage. Midway, sample with a thickness gauge and touch up deviations. After drying and cooling, inspect the entire appearance. Sand and recoat immediately if particles or runs appear.

In one sentence: give each workpiece an even protective layer. The work includes pretreatment, spraying, coating-thickness control, drying, and appearance inspection, combining paint mist and tools with process management and appearance quality.
